title: Identify exclusively virtual schools (Virtual = 'F') with an SAT excellence
question: Identify exclusively virtual schools (Virtual = 'F') with an SAT excellence rate above 0.2. Among these, return those whose eligible free meal rate for students aged 5–17 exceeds the average such rate across all locally funded schools. For each qualifying school, list its name, city, and the difference between its K–12 and ages 5–17 enrollment.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    s."XCL_047" AS name,
    s."XCL_050" AS city,
    (f."XCL_019" - f."XCL_024") AS enrollment_diff
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f."XCL_001" = s."XCL_041"
JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat."XCL_030" = s."XCL_041"
WHERE s."XCL_076" = 'F'
  AND CAST(sat."XCL_040" AS REAL) / sat."XCL_036" > 0.2
  AND f."XCL_026" > (
      SELECT AVG(f2."XCL_026")
      FROM frpm AS f2
      JOIN schools AS s2 ON s2."XCL_041" = f2."XCL_001"
      WHERE s2."XCL_065" = 'Locally funded'
  )
